summary: Framework mở cho xây dựng AI agents, hỗ trợ markdown, workflows và môi trường thực thi sandbox.
usecases: Rapid prototyping of AI agents processing markdown documents and executing tool-based workflows.
Building multi-agent systems with shared sandboxes and defined workflows.
Developing agentic applications requiring persistent state, markdown instructions, and Vercel deployment.
ideas: Combine Eve with a vector database for agents retrieving and reasoning over external knowledge bases.
Use Eve as orchestration layer for a personal AI assistant managing calendars, emails, and code generation.
Deploy Eve-based agents on Vercel Edge Functions for low-latency, user-specific AI interactions.
